'''Dryon''' was a [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of the [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] religion. He was the leader of [[Oasis (community)|Oasis]], a commune of Dim-U adherents who lived in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Amongst the monks of the [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]], he bathed more often than the street peachers, and wearing nicer [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="TM" />
